intended_object: Given a class W of morphisms in T and an object X, this is the property of objects of the slice category T/X that holds for (Y, f : Y → X) exactly when the structure morphism f is in W. Inferred from the docstring and the name.
explanation: The body `fun f ↦ W f.hom` holds for an object of `Over X` exactly when its structure morphism lies in W, which is the intended object. The definition works for any category T, any morphism property W and any object X, so it is not too narrow. The dual notion `underObj` exists in the same file, and the two are related by rfl lemmas through the op-equivalences. A search turned up no other Mathlib declaration that defines the same object property. This is the basic notion, stated at its natural generality, so it is faithful.
